items.title: Entrepreneurship in Pakistan and the Digital Economy

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Entrepreneurship in Pakistan and the Digital Economy under 9.4 as printed (PDF 131, printed 127).

blocks.text: Entrepreneurship in Pakistan is growing rapidly due to increased access to the internet and mobile technology. Many young people are starting online businesses through social media, e-commerce platforms, and freelancing websites. The digital economy is creating new job opportunities in areas such as software development, digital marketing, and online services. Government and private initiatives are also supporting startups and innovation. This growth is helping improve the country’s economy and encouraging youth to become job creators instead of job seekers.
